title: fix(app-shell): an open Studio shows drafts and publishes made outside its tab without a reload
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoJfFFjCwfyYEHghqHHzTqdM)_

Fixes #32592

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：已打开的 Studio 在标签页重新可见或窗口获得焦点时重读草稿台账，标签页可见期间每 30 秒再读一次；读到的结果与上次不同，就发出本页已有的元数据刷新信号，「变更」角标、条目头部草稿行和各支柱的草稿标记一起更新。
- 为什么改：agent 经 MCP 写的草稿、REST 发布或另一个标签页的改动，原先要手动刷新浏览器才看得到，用户会以为 agent 没改成（裁决 6844196863，C 分两期，本 PR 为第一期 B）。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端一个 hook；隐藏的标签页一个请求都不发，不会让缩容到零的后端常醒；结果不变时只多一次读。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/usePendingDrafts.ts`（`checkWatchedLedgers` 与 `armWatchTimer`），其次 `usePendingDrafts.test.tsx` 新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：开着 Studio 切到别的标签页，用 REST 在同一包里存一条草稿，切回 Studio，「变更」按钮上的数字立即变化，无需刷新。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：已按 pm-dispatch 审核清单核对：只在标签页可见时轮询（30 秒），切回或聚焦时立刻读一次，隐藏时零请求；草稿清单有变化才发刷新信号，角标、草稿标记和对象元数据一起更新；服务端推送（第二阶段 #33023）不在本次范围。可落地。

## What changes

`usePendingDrafts` is the one reader of the `_drafts` ledger. Its refresh pulse (`emitMetadataRefresh`) is an in-memory, per-tab listener set, so nothing written outside the tab (an MCP agent, a REST caller, another tab) ever reached an open Studio.

While any hook is mounted, the module now keeps a reference-counted set of the scopes the mounted hooks read (one `_drafts` URL each) and checks them:

- **on return**: `visibilitychange` to visible, and window `focus` (a tab switch fires both; the second joins the first check, so one read);
- **on a poll** every `PENDING_DRAFTS_POLL_MS` = 30 s while the tab is visible. The ruling's range was 15 to 30 s. The top of it is enough because the read that matters, coming back from the MCP client or the other tab, goes out at once on return. The timer only covers a Studio left visible beside the client making the change, and 30 s halves the requests of 15 s.

A check reads each watched scope once, through the existing in-flight share, so N hooks of one scope cost one read. Each settled read records a fingerprint of its answer per transport and URL. When a check's answer differs from the one this tab last read, the check sends the tab's own `emitMetadataRefresh()`, and everything already on that pulse converges together:

- every `usePendingDrafts` (the Changes badge, the home banner, the chat bar, the preview bar);
- Studio's item header line (`studioItemDraftStatus`, fed by the surface's hook through `StudioPendingDraftsContext`);
- the pillars' re-reads (`useMetadataRefreshNonce`), which carry the per-key draft marks: the Data pillar re-reads its open object on the pulse;
- the package app resolver, the customization marks and `MetadataProvider`.

So the badge and the marks agree. An unchanged answer sends nothing more. The fingerprint is only compared, never served as an answer, so the module's "not a response cache" rule stands.

**Hidden tab.** The poll consults `hiddenTabPollStop.ts` (`isPollingSuspended`) when it arms and when it fires, and it is stricter than that rule: a hidden tab clears the timer and sends no request at all. Coming back is the one read, and the visible cadence resumes from there. Unmounting the last hook removes both listeners and the timer.

**Checklist.** `studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle` acceptance[6].verify no longer expects an outside publish to show only after a reload, with revision 13 in the item's history.

No server change, no `packages/spec` change, and no change to `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: the item marks already listen to the pulse this check sends. Phase 2, server-pushed draft and publish events, is #33023 and out of scope; this check stays its fallback when a push connection drops.

## Tests

Head `36f74ea0` (`main` merged once at `28a2f0f5`). Each pin lives in the shared harness file it belongs to:

- `preview/usePendingDrafts.test.tsx`, new describe "a change made outside the tab reaches the hook without a reload":
  - a draft staged while the tab is hidden shows after `visibilitychange` to visible, with no pulse sent by the test (the return read, then the pulse's re-read: exactly 2 ledger reads);
  - focus reads again;
  - an unchanged answer costs one read and sends zero pulses;
  - with fake timers, nothing at 29.999 s, then exactly one read per 30 s tick across three hooks of one scope, and a tick that finds a change updates all three;
  - hidden for 40 ticks makes zero requests, the return makes one, and the cadence resumes;
  - the last unmount stops the poll and the listeners;
  - CONTROL: the in-tab pulse (Studio's own save or publish) still refreshes at once, not at the next tick.
- `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.itemDraftLine-12725.test.tsx`, new describe "a draft an agent stages outside the tab reaches the open item when the tab is visible again":
  - on one return, the Changes count reads 2, the header line reads 「Draft · 2 unpublished」 and the Data pillar re-reads its open object's draft (where its draft marks come from);
  - CONTROL: a return to an unchanged ledger re-reads no item.

<details><summary>Runs (all under scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh, from ui/)</summary>

- The new pins plus the hook's other two suites (`afterSave-11787`, `inflightShare-11797`) and the item-line harness: Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 31 passed (31).
- Every ui test file importing the changed surface (`usePendingDrafts`, `StudioDesignSurface`, `DraftPreviewBar`, `PendingDraftsBar`, `HomePage`, `draftStatus`), 244 files, run in two batches:
  - the 66 that touch visibility, focus, fake timers or the `_drafts` URL: Test Files 66 passed (66), Tests 399 passed (399);
  - the other 178: Test Files 178 passed (178), Tests 1251 passed (1251).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both programs, `tsconfig.test.json` included): VERDICT command-exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (committed first; scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restore proven)</summary>

The anchor `document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onWatchVisibility);` was replaced with a comment. On disk: anchor x1 to x0, blob `afced872` to `d8403f21`. Four pins went red:

- the hook's return pin;
- the unchanged-answer pin;
- the hidden-then-return pin;
- the Studio item-line pin.

Test Files 2 failed (2), Tests 4 failed | 18 passed (22). The focus pin and the poll pins stayed green, as they should, since the focus listener and the timer are untouched. Restore: blob after restore == blob at HEAD (`afced872`), `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **e2e not added.** The ruling's acceptance (stage a draft by REST, switch back, the badge updates) is held by the component pins above, which drive the real hook, the real Studio surface and the real Data pillar against a stubbed `_drafts`. A browser e2e would need a staged-draft fixture plus a tab-visibility switch. Playwright's single page cannot hide itself the way a background tab does, so the run would have to fake `document.hidden`, and that is what the jsdom pins already do. The e2e is not run, and this note says so.
- **Cost of a change.** A check that finds a moved answer costs its own read plus the pulse's re-read per scope (the pulse clears in-flight reads by design, so a read sent before it cannot answer after it). The pulse also refetches `MetadataProvider`'s loaded types, the same work a copilot draft or an in-tab publish already causes. It runs only when the ledger moved.
- **Scope.** The check is hook-wide, not Studio-only, because the hook is the one ledger reader and the ruling names the hook. So the home banner, the chat bar and the draft preview bar also catch up without a reload. Their pages already poll the bell feeds while visible (`sharedUserFeeds`), so a visible tab was never idle against a scale-to-zero backend. A hidden one stays idle.
- **An in-tab write that tells nobody.** A write that never announces itself (the ledger moved, no pulse) is caught by the next check, which sends the pulse. That is the intended fallback, not a second dialect.
- **Merge of `main`.** The merge brought only `packages/mcp`, `packages/runtime`, docs and one changeset, none of them in the app-shell closure. So no rebuild or re-test ran for it. The derived gate list is byte-identical before and after it, and the fast families were re-run on the merged head.
- **Ruling-marker grep** of the file surface (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`) found one hit: the hook's "⛔ Not a response cache" rule. It is kept, and the fingerprint map is documented under it as compare-only.

All 43 ran with `</dev/null`, exit codes recorded before any pipe. `--ran` printed: "43 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 43 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 43 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".

  - `check:type-check-debt` first hit the 300 s wrapper timeout while queued behind the lock, then re-ran to exit 0 ("0 raw tsc error(s) total").
- On the merged head `36f74ea0` the derivation is unchanged, and these re-ran to exit 0: `check:platform-checklist`, `check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`.
